_comment: The complete set of tailos files that may become public. Nothing outside this list is ever read or published. Questions live with the document that answers them, so removing a document also removes its suggestions.
_redact_comment: TAIL OS is not a public project. These patterns are stripped from every document before rendering, and the build fails if one survives into the output.

home._comment: Front-page claims. Everything here is asserted to the public without a citation, so it must be true and checkable in the published documents. quickstart repeats the commands of the Quick Start page.
